_help: MCP servers the agents may use. Each runs inside the tools container, which has internet but none of your files or Mission Control's keys. env: only the variables named here reach that server; "$NAME" is read from tools/.env. readOnly: true marks every tool of the server as read-only; otherwise a tool is read-only only if it says so itself (readOnlyHint), and per-tool settings under tools override both (readOnly, enabled). Tools that change things ask the user before every call.

wikipedia.description: Search Wikipedia and read articles (no key needed)

brave.description: Web and news search with the Brave Search API (needs BRAVE_API_KEY in tools/.env)

espn.description: Live scores, betting lines, box scores, recaps, team schedules, news and trending stories for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college, MLS, EPL and WNBA (no key needed)
espn.notes: sport and league go in pairs: basketball nba, basketball wnba, basketball mens-college-basketball, football nfl, football college-football, baseball mlb, hockey nhl, soccer eng.1 (Premier League), soccer usa.1 (MLS). today needs neither. Game ids for boxscore and recap come from scores.
espn._only: Lookups that return usable results (checked 2026-11-18). Left out: standings, leaders, injuries, scoreboard_get and rankings_get (their results are 0.2-2.4 MB and ignore select, so they always exceed the size limit), h2h, rivals and streak (need a local sync first), watch (polls forever), duplicates, import/export and the learnings/teach/playbook tools that edit its local knowledge base.
espn._hideParams: Command-line plumbing the agents don't need; agent mode (compact JSON, no prompts) is always on.

images.description: Make pictures from a description with the image model on this PC's graphics card (ComfyUI, about 1.5 minutes each)
images.notes: Write the prompt in English as a visual description (subject, setting, light, style). One call makes one picture; it is attached to the card by itself, so just say what you made.

code.description: Read Mission Control's own source code (the GAMFace-HQ repository as last committed): list, read and search files, recent commits and their diffs. Read-only.
code.notes: Paths start at the repository root: the app is under mission-control/ (src/hq for the agents, src/ui.ts for the server, ui/src for the dashboard, tools/ for the tools service, README-HQ.md for the docs). Search first, then read the files you need. It shows committed code only, not unsaved changes.

github.description: GitHub, read-only: repositories and their files, branches and commits, issues, pull requests and Actions runs (GitHub's own MCP server; needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in tools/.env)
github.notes: Mission Control's own repository is Gamface/GAMFace-HQ (owner Gamface, repo GAMFace-HQ, default branch main).

inspo.description: Design references: screenshots, palettes, fonts, type scales, spacing and page structures from 832 curated real websites, plus reference components (Inspo, free hosted MCP server, no key)
inspo.notes: For a new page or redesign: start with recommend(brief) for 5 exemplar sites, a layout pattern and a palette; then get_design_system(slug) for exact fonts, colours and spacing, and get_screen(slug) for the screenshots. search_screens(query) finds pages by style ('editorial dark SaaS pricing'). Report site names, URLs and the exact tokens so the Coder can build from them. Not for projects that already have a design system.

demo.description: A built-in test server: echo text back, tell the time, and a pretend note writer (it changes nothing, but says it would)
